risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed but contains extensive standard forward-looking-statement disclaimers and some nonspecific customer references. Results show material revenue and profitability declines, restructuring charges, customer concentration effects, and exposure to demand, execution, and financially troubled customer risks, partially offset by improved operating cash flow and portfolio diversification.
